primaryChecks.text: Amon was twenty-two years old when he began to reign; and he reigned two years in Jerusalem. His mother’s name was Meshullemeth the daughter of Haruz of Jotbah.
primaryChecks.previousContext: Manasseh slept with his fathers, and was buried in the garden of his own house, in the garden of Uzza; and Amon his son reigned in his place.
primaryChecks.nextContext: He did that which was evil in the LORD’s sight, as Manasseh his father did.
